role: Predeclared causal probability audit, not fitted yet and not independent acceptance
target: Same T+20 fixed +/-5% three-class outcome. Frozen point-decision policy remains unchanged; calibrated argmax F1 reported separately.
methods: causal multinomial logistic calibration of decision scores
causal multinomial logistic calibration of component masses

calibration.features: Three centered log scores clipped at1e-6 plus fixed one-hot selected-expert categories from frozen pool; StandardScaler fitted only on allowed calibration rows.
calibration.timing: All fitting labels must have label_end_date strictly before block first eligible forecast. Last504 matured OOF forecast rows only. Never random CV or in-sample base-model outputs.

baseline.rule: Class frequency from last504 FULL INDEX-calendar mature outcomes before same calibration refit boundary; Laplace1 smoothing.
baseline.rationale: Use actual older known labels for a competent prior, not a uniform cold-start strawman.
baseline.fallback: If fewer252 matured OOF rows or any class fewer10, output same causal prior for calibration method; keep all forecast dates.

evaluation.coverage: Report all1560 days AND active-calibrator subset on identical dates across compared methods; disclose warmup/fallback.
metrics: macro F1 from calibrated argmax, separate from unchanged frozen decision
evaluation.folds: Original4 development folds; do not change boundaries
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired20/60-session block sensitivity; repeats1000,seed42; history reused, no multiple-testing-adjusted significance claim.
evaluation.screening: On active dates, both proper scores must improve vs causal prior and Brier improve in at least3/4 folds; paired improvement lower bounds >0 for both20/60 blocks. Passing still not independent acceptance.

limitations: Probability calibration cannot repair absent discrimination or certify economic utility.
Historical outcomes and earlier model variants repeatedly inspected.
Do not expose decision-score maximum as calibrated confidence or replace production automatically.
